cases.name: privileged
cases.attempt: Attempt a privileged operation through the actual executor; inspect effective Privileged and denial before tenant work.

cases.name: root_user
cases.attempt: Submit an image docker:user root override; require refusal or a verified non-root UID.

cases.name: host_network
cases.attempt: Attempt host network access and inspect the actual container network namespace.

cases.name: host_pid
cases.attempt: Attempt access to host processes; inspect PidMode and namespace isolation.

cases.name: host_ipc
cases.attempt: Attempt host IPC access; inspect IpcMode and namespace isolation.

cases.name: host_path
cases.attempt: Attempt host filesystem access and inspect every mount source.

cases.name: host_device
cases.attempt: Attempt access to a host device; inspect device grants and actual refusal.

cases.name: added_capability
cases.attempt: Attempt a capability-requiring operation; inspect CapAdd and effective process capabilities.

cases.name: docker_socket
cases.attempt: Attempt Docker daemon socket access from build/helper containers; inspect mount sources.

cases.name: manager_credentials
cases.attempt: Attempt manager token, IRSA and Fleeting connector credential access; inspect all container mounts.

cases.name: arbitrary_image
cases.attempt: Submit a non-allowlisted image through valid GitLab CI YAML; require executor refusal before scripts.

cases.name: arbitrary_service
cases.attempt: Submit a non-allowlisted or root service through valid GitLab CI YAML; require refusal before scripts.

cases.name: debug_trace
cases.attempt: Submit CI_DEBUG_TRACE=true and verify the pinned executor disables tracing without emitting credentials.
